title: England–Spain and seven other ties fill Saturday’s Nations League slate
summary: Saturday’s 2026/27 Nations League programme is settled across the groups: San Marino 0-7 Finland, North Macedonia 0-3 Switzerland, Czech Republic 1-2 Croatia, Albania 2-0 Belarus, Faroe Islands 1-1 Kazakhstan, Slovakia 2-0 Moldova, Bulgaria 1-2 Luxembourg and Iceland 1-1 Estonia all finished, with Slovenia 0-0 Scotland and England 2-3 Spain deciding the remaining League A fixtures.
